Migrate a plaintext project .env file into the vault

Usage: kprun migrate [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>  Path to a standard .env file (KEY=value lines)

Options:
      --entry <ENTRY>  Vault entry title (default: name of the directory containing the file)
      --merge          Merge keys into an existing entry with this title
      --gitignore      Add the file's name to .gitignore without asking
      --delete         Delete the source file after a successful import
  -h, --help           Print help
